digest.component_or_area: code review criteria routing and documentation
propositions: The model emits criteria labels 'sec' and 'documentation' as synonyms of 'security' and 'docs' respectively; these unmapped labels fall to the default 0.95 threshold instead of their criterion's tuned value.

A CRITERIA_SYNONYMS mapping and normalize_criteria function must be added to registry.py and applied in code_review_decide before routing/threshold lookup, with rules to preserve effective vocabulary membership and pass through unmapped labels unchanged.

The calibration document contains five load-bearing mistakes (A–E) mischaracterizing 'sec', 'documentation', and 'project.review-phase-boundaries' as non-LLM-tunable or low-data, conflating packaged vs effective vocabulary, and recommending a rejected closed-schema constraint.

After normalization, findings with the canonical criteria id (security/docs) receive their criterion's tuned threshold while open dimensions and project criteria pass through unchanged, keeping high-impact docs findings surfaced.
